body:
Approved spec: .adlc/specs/SC-019-v21-wizard-real-offers.md (v2.1, builds on SC-014). Do not edit the specs. Do not call Gemini or any live API in tests. Do not commit secrets, personal data, or the e-bill PDFs. Money is integer LKR. A percent discount is (amount * rate_bps) // 10000. Hard cut-off 17:00 Colombo 18 Oct 2026 (assumption C8).

Guided wizard UI for v2.1 (spec in-scope items 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9 UI, 11).
One step per response with Back and Next, state in hidden fields (C9); planning date select 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-31 labeled a demo control, default 2026-10-22, auto-submit on change with an Update button fallback (C7); an Add an item select over catalog items not already due or soon; Upload a receipt photo (multipart, forwarded to /v1/receipts, never stored or logged, rate limited) and Use sample receipt, with the added and left-out lines listed; Extract this image removed; offer-minimum suggestions only from pantry items not in the basket, eligible, due within 14 days, at most three, never added by the page, with the engine re-planned total and the sentence Only if you need these soon. Savvy Cart does not add them.; Wallet offers max stores 1 to 4; real offers show Minimum and cap are assumptions; check the bank's terms.; Approve offers Pickup or Delivery (MOCK) with an assumed fee per bill (default LKR 350, editable) and No booking is made. Savvy Cart is not integrated with Uber, PickMe, or any store. plus MOCK and No order is sent.
tests/test_v2_page.py is updated to the wizard; its guarantees stay (accessibility, bills and savings, re-plan disclosure and grounding, no-model 503, injection, rate limit, malformed state).
README.md describes the v2.1 judge path; python scripts/check_judge_readme.py still passes.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Planning date is a bounded demo control. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_planning_date_is_a_bounded_demo_control -q
2. One step at a time. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_wizard_shows_one_step_at_a_time -q
3. Shopper can add a catalog item. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_shopper_can_add_a_catalog_item -q
4. Uploaded receipt adds listed lines. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_uploaded_receipt_adds_listed_lines -q
5. Suggestions use only items due soon. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_offer_minimum_suggestions_use_only_items_due_soon -q
6. Approve offers a mock delivery quote. Verify: python -m pytest tests/test_v21_page.py::test_approve_offers_a_mock_delivery_quote -q
7. Every test passes. Verify: python -m pytest -q
8. README checker passes. Verify: python scripts/check_judge_readme.py
title: v2.1 wizard: bounded date, add item, receipt upload, suggestions, mock delivery
